title: The Legendary Con Artist
overview: A naive young woman named Nao is dragged into the Liar Game and seeks the assistance of a notorious conman.

title: Shockwave
overview: Nao and Akiyama crank up the pressure to try to retrieve Nao's millions.

title: Resolution
overview: The first round of the Liar Game reaches its end and a new round begins.

title: Minority Rule
overview: Nao frets over her chance of survival as the rules of the Minority Rule game are explained.

title: Alliance
overview: Akiyama and Nao proceed further into the Minority Rule game with their alliance strategy.

title: Initiative
overview: With the player known as X revealed, the Minority Rule game enters a terrifying new stage.

title: The Losers' Revival
overview: The Minority Rule comes to its shocking conclusion, and Nao seeks a way to get back into the game.

title: Downsizing Game
overview: Leronira explains what this game will entail, and the players begin making their first plans.

title: Light and Darkness
overview: Nao makes a desperate ploy to climb out from the depths of despair.

title: Salvation
overview: The other Revival Round players scramble for the votes to save themselves.

title: Contraband Game
overview: Leronira introduces the surviving players to the complex rules of the Contraband Game.

title: Yokoya
overview: The game begins, and both teams lay out the strategies they will follow in the opening rounds.

title: Fissures
overview: Kikuzawa tests his surefire method for detecting contraband, while Akiyama and Nao try to figure out Yokoya.

title: Dictatorship
overview: The Country of Day team corners Kikuzawa to make him reveal how he knew Yokoya before entering the game.

title: Secret Plan
overview: Akiyama comes up with a plan to compensate for the Country of Day's weaknesses, but Yokoya also makes a move.

title: Turbulence
overview: Akiyama concocts a new plan to pull his team out of a hopeless situation.

title: Tip-off
overview: The curtain is pulled back on the Country of Night and the system of control used by Yokoya.

title: Caution
overview: Yokoya learns of Akiyama's plot and begins his counter-strategy.

title: Solidarity
overview: The Contraband Game reaches its climax and the final standings are revealed.

title: Provocation
overview: After the smuggling game ends, it is time to see how much money each player has earned.

title: Spearhead Match
overview: The rules for the Spearhead Match are explained and Fukunaga comes strong out of the gate.

title: Trap
overview: Nao notices a contradiction in the Spearhead Match incentives.

title: Core Match
overview: The rules of Seventeen Poker are explained and appear to give Akiyama's opponent an advantage.
